contract: BB14 server: CombatService.DamagePlayer(victim, amount, attacker, crit, sourceKind) records { Kind, T } per victim when no attacker (MonsterService passes the monster kind, the kaiju stomp "Kaiju"). After the death pipeline the victim alone gets Net.Fx 'KO' { By, Name, Faction, Lost, Sack, RespawnIn }: By = Player (a PvP killer; Name = PublicName, Faction) > Kaiju (a stomp within 3 s; the kaiju's PublicName) > Monster (a hit within Config.Death.SourceSeconds; Config.MonsterTypes name) > Fall (free fall, the body gone, or 30 below its zone's floor at the moment it fell) > Other. Lost = the pouch difference over steps 1-2 (plunder, the bounty KO share), Sack = a grudge sack was carried. The source is forgotten after each death.
limitations: Offline doubles as in tools/test_ranking.py (dev2_world.luau). The client DeathScreen (overlay, tips, closing on respawn) is the 게임성 개발 session's; real falls / resets in Studio are checked after the merge.
